info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 學生已修習熱流相關基礎學科：熱力學、流體力學及熱傳學，再利用機械工程實驗安排熱流實驗項目，使學生充分理解物質有關的性質、能量的轉換以及熱傳與質傳的關係。
description.describe_eh:
1.	To afford practical illustrations of the principles advanced in the classroom.
2.	To measure thermal conductivity, flash-point temperature, surface tension, heating value.
3.	To understand the relations needed in engineering practices.
4.	To test brake power and ascertain the efficiency of heat engines.

targets.describe_ch: 熱傳導率、閃點溫度、表面張力、燃料熱值、流體黏度實驗，使學生具備熱流相關專業知識。
targets.describe_en: Measure thermal conductivity,  flash- point temperature ,  surface  tension, heating value,  viscosity  the  basic properties of thermal fluid science.

targets.describe_ch: 流場觀測，管路摩擦損失實驗提升學生流體流動方面的分析能力。
targets.describe_en: Promote the analysis ability of fluid flow by laminar flow and pipe-flow friction loss test.

targets.describe_ch: 分組實驗使學生具有效溝通及團隊精神及合作分工。
targets.describe_en: Class is divided into nine groups. After performing   experiment ,  students behave   effective  communication , team-work and cooperative.

targets.describe_ch: 轉速、引擎馬力、熱管熱交換器、蒸汽動力循環實驗，提升學生對熱流理論應用的能力。
targets.describe_en: Revolution  speed ,  engine  power output, steam-power cycle understand the performance of heat engines.

targets.describe_ch: 火焰傳播速度及電子元件熱傳實驗綜合理論應用能力的提升。
targets.describe_en: Flame  propagation  velocity  and electronic device cooling experiments emphasize the understanding of thermal-fluid science.

targets.describe_ch: 學生有蒐集資料、規劃設備、整理數據及作結論的能力。
targets.describe_en: Promote the ability for the data taken, report written and analysis.
